servers.title: Servers
servers.intro: What this app can talk to, and what is going to answer. The product asks for capabilities — chat, image, video, speech, search — never for a company: a server on this computer, a service in the cloud or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint will do.
servers.nothing_set_up: Nothing is set up for this yet.
servers.default_no_key: The default has no key: {name} would answer instead.
servers.asked_every: Asked every server. A remote one is not really tested: only its key is checked, because the only honest test would spend your credit.
